description: This file defines the COBBusinessStepService interface, which declares methods related to executing and retrieving COB business steps within the Finereact system.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a COB business step based on the provided execution map and item, returning the processed item.

methods.name: getCOBBusinessSteps
methods.description: Retrieves a set of BusinessStepNameAndOrder objects for the specified business step class and COB job name.
